snippet.title: SHROUD OF THE WOODS | New Indie Psychological Horror Game 2026
snippet.description:
A peaceful weekend getaway quickly turns into a nightmare when your dog, Pablo, suddenly disappears into the suffocating darkness of the forest. Your goal is to find him, no matter what it takes. After all... is there a better way to escape the gray everyday routine?
